CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2579 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e. Bus nonce: 81dae66295437b957b448f2bf182113d. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e` or `Fix review: blocked e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 81dae66295437b957b448f2bf182113d`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2579 e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2579-81dae662`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2579 at head e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e, after a cloud fixer round on the blocked verdict at eb9f7e89d0b258ca66a8d9757df0156a776b7332. Read every open block with `git fetch origin review/2579; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` and confirm each is cleared at this head; check what changed with git diff eb9f7e89d0b258ca66a8d9757df0156a776b7332...e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e. Group: the PR's own roster group (read its delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2579.md and the roster).
Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at that head, with the finder's harness the group brief names (roster: origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, read with jq), never the fixer's. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Mutation proof yourself for every arm the block named, plus fresh one-line mutants of the touched code; the finder's harness at both ends; a null control for every quantified claim.
- Re-measure every figure in the PR body at this head; report each as re-derived or not re-derivable.
- carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over the body reports 0 unrouted; every Carry in your verdict names a live group (stage not done) present on origin/main's roster (main's roster is what pr-contract reads).
- ## Red checks: read the check-runs API per commit at this head. Main was red 2026-10-22 02:52Z-04:35Z (orchestrator.md over cap, fixed by #2595 at dcf12f490); a red from that window on an older head is main-caused. nightly-status grades main.
- git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main e53fee3670d81481bd25d255f3f27365e287c12e must be clean; do not ask for a main absorb on a clean head.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full 40-hex head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 81dae66295437b957b448f2bf182113d. No absolute /Users/ or /private/ path anywhere in VERDICT.md or ev/ (the bus poster refuses host paths).
